a1
After twenty years with Laban, the Lord told Jacob: go home. I will be with you.
a2
Jacob left in secret with his wives, children, and flocks. Rachel stole her father's household gods.
b1
Laban chased them for seven days. In a dream, God warned him: be careful what you say to Jacob.
b2
Laban said: why did you flee in secret, and why did you steal my gods?
c1
Jacob said: whoever has them will not live. He did not know Rachel had taken them. Laban searched, and found nothing.
c2
Jacob answered: for twenty years I served you, and you changed my wages ten times. Without God, you would have sent me away empty.
d1
They piled up stones as a witness. Laban said: the Lord watch between us when we are out of each other's sight.
e1
Next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and daughters, blessed them, and went home.
h1
For twenty years Jacob worked hard while his wages kept changing.
h2
When he finally spoke, he said: God saw my hardship.
h3
God sees the unfairness no one else notices, and he is with you in it.
h4
Today, tell God what no one else has seen.
i
What are you carrying that no one sees?
